confirmedStory: Maker fitted a left shoulder plate backward, removed it, and fitted it again; its edge remained different.
Mechanic added an iron brace that carried load the old bronze could not; a later description places wedge-shaped marks beneath a Victorian strap.
Advanced discovered the twice-fitted plate, respected the short left travel, and retained the original construction.
unknown: whether the later strap also functions as a stop

options.label: Original plate limits travel; later brace carries load

options.Mechanic: Add a separate visible iron strap/brace and brass bearing as later load-path repair; leave original stop legible and preserve its range.
options.Advanced: Retain both and map the actuator to the inherited restricted range.

options.Advanced: Retain both and respect their combined restricted range.
